siteSettings.title: English Adventures: A Lot Of - Much - Many

modules.name: Learn
modules.title: Quantity Words Lessons
modules.instructions: Master the use of A LOT OF, MUCH, and MANY for expressing large quantities. Learn the differences between countable and uncountable nouns.

modules.name: Write
modules.title: Writing Practice
modules.instructions: Write sentences using A LOT OF, MUCH, and MANY correctly. Practice with different contexts and noun types.

modules.name: Play
modules.title: Grammar Games
modules.instructions: Play games to practice choosing the correct quantity word based on countable vs uncountable nouns.

modules.name: Quiz
modules.title: Quick Quiz
modules.instructions: Test your knowledge with multiple choice questions about quantity words. Choose the correct quantifier!

modules.name: Apply
modules.title: Quantity Challenge
modules.instructions: Apply quantity words correctly in sentences. Master the rules for countable and uncountable nouns.
